dog.description_text:
AVAILABLE FOR FOSTER ONLY

Storm is a wiggly bundle of fun with a big smile on her face. She’s a petite girl with a big personality! Storm is searching for her forever home where she can settle and truly enjoy the life of a normal dog, with love and security. You’ll receive so much more in return.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.

Apply to adopt: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/dog-adoption-application

Apply to foster: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/dog-foster-application

Learn about our adoption process, eligibility, and fees: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/adopt

Read our fostering FAQs and eligibility requirements: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/foster

View available dogs and current adoption promotions: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/adoptable-dogs

View upcoming adoption events: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org/adoption-events

Learn more about us and ways to get involved: www.nycsecondchancerescue.org
